model_policy: User-requested YOLOv8s extension compared with completed expanded YOLOv8n; no automatic replacement of the restricted-cohort primary study
checkpoint_selection: best.pt by maximum validation macro mAP50:95 over the fixed 60 epochs; upstream later epoch wins exact ties

evaluation.budget_rationale: Predeclared classroom comparison budget, not a clinically justified acceptable rate
evaluation.selection_rule: Maximize malignant detection recall within benign image false-alert budget; ties: precision, fewer benign alerts, higher threshold

design_notes: 60 epochs is a fixed budget, not a convergence claim
No oversampling; no Mosaic/mixup/cutmix; flips only, preserve color and lesion context
Optional Albumentations removed from runtime transform list
No n/s comparison to old cohort as a causal improvement claim
Equal batch/nbs prevents different gradient accumulation budgets
No training or validation uses reassessment images
Exploratory expansion adds every eligible binary-labelled missing-lesion image to training only.
Known links to held-out components are excluded; unrecorded links remain possible.
Equal epochs do not mean equal optimizer calls; this compares the expanded-data training package, not a pure data-size effect.
Primary comparison: malignant AP50 on identical existing validation images; also macro AP50:95 and fixed 0.05/0.50 thresholds.
Retain the original 10% false-alert selection as an additional comparison; do not rewrite old locks.

release_decision.basis: User explicitly requested s with the same expanded training data, training settings, validation set and thresholds as n
release_decision.run_scope: YOLOv8s fresh original COCO start; 60 epochs; identical validation grid; no reassessment inference
